items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: And, and old man, Bob was on the alto.

ctx.x: Yeah. He used to go to writing for the bass. And that old man would write too, buddy. He could put some stuff on paper. And, and old man, Bob was on the alto.
Taton played baritone? Yeah, it was baritone, but I had to. Because that's, that's God, man. And Trapania on bass drumming you on.
